method: Hand-labelled from per-track crop thumbnails (results/eval/all_tracks_*.jpg) with candidate repeats re-checked at higher resolution across three frames each (results/eval/grp_*.jpg).
coverage_policy: Only tracks whose identity can be called with confidence are labelled. Most shot 3-8 b-roll faces are 40-100 px profiles that cannot be reliably matched by eye; labelling them by guess would fabricate the ground truth, so they are excluded. Pairwise metrics are computed over labelled pairs only, so a singleton here asserts only that it differs from the other LABELLED tracks - not that it appears nowhere else.

excluded_examples.tracks_70_73_75: black cap + dark jacket, plausibly one person, faces too occluded to confirm
excluded_examples.track_76: red cap like 61/69 but no glasses visible and different skin tone - unresolved
